title: checkin_resource.c: stale header comment claims all responses go through coap_oscore_respond_resource
description: Found in correctness review of untq fix. File-header comment (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/checkin_resource.c:12-13) says 'all handler responses go through coap_oscore_respond_resource()', but both GET handlers and their error paths respond via plain lichen_coap_respond() (:212 :223 :327 :336) - unauthenticated GET responses intentionally carry no OSCORE wrapper. Fix the comment (2 lines), no code change.
close_reason: Already fixed; header comment (lines 8-15) accurately describes mixed OSCORE/plaintext response paths.
